subject.title: fix(ui): restore reload history and bundled icons

question: Should the baseline Control UI `connect-src` policy permit `data:` URLs globally to support bundled Web Awesome system icons?
rationale: The change is narrow and does not add a remote origin, but CSP policy is an intentional security boundary and repository automation cannot decide the acceptable permanent baseline.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Keep `data:` in the baseline directive after a real browser run proves the bundled icons and reload flow without CSP or console errors.

options.title: Avoid the CSP expansion
options.body: Rework or register the icon-loading path so bundled system icons render without fetching `data:` URLs, retaining the previous baseline directive.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep `data:` in the baseline directive after a real browser run proves the bundled icons and reload flow without CSP or console errors.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available adjacent Control UI history and is connected to both affected surfaces.
